patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Customer.io and Moosend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Customer.io only if your buying job matches “Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to c” rather than Moosend's shape. Choose Moosend only if your buying job matches “Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited sends.” rather than Customer.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Customer.io leans ecommerce-email; Moosend leans small-business-campaigns. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Customer.io and Moosend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Customer.io is Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to classic ESPs.; Moosend is Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited sends..
- Company-size focus: Customer.io (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Moosend (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Customer.io-leaning ecommerce-email vs Moosend-leaning small-business-campaigns.
- Researched limits: Customer.io — Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP; Moosend — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry.

Limitations — Customer.io: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP; Event/profile model requires product data maturity; Moosend: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry; Exact contact-tier dollars require the live calculator.

Poor-fit cases: Customer.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP · Moosend is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry · Avoid Customer.io if you actually need Moosend's motion (Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
